Meta MR Utility Kit 207.0.1 is the unmodified official package from
https://npm.developer.oculus.com/com.meta.xr.mrutilitykit/-/com.meta.xr.mrutilitykit-207.0.1.tgz

The package contains Meta's SDK license and notices. Registry SHA512:
`RXUWVAQqrHDNOHBaTd4ztLu6d8qRakdxMPIrCu3rV1oXx6fUWyd+HJBDAVr+2lR9l4YR7A0757ix7w2lL7LJAA==`

The local tarball makes the room-setup companion reproducible when Unity's registry
download aborts. Core SDK remains 207.0.1. The PC app retains its existing camera rig
and uses Core Scene APIs; only the separate Quest Room Setup scene instantiates MRUK.
